description: Compare each timing group's average institutional ownership with the overall per-snapshot average. For the groups above it, report the mean of their averages and their mean excess.

b.request: Group records by event announcement timing (with missing timings as their own separate group), calculate each group's mean institutional ownership percentage, identify which groups have a mean strictly exceeding the overall per-snapshot mean institutional ownership, and report a single row containing the mean of those above-average groups' mean ownership values and the mean of those groups' individual excesses above the overall average.
b.sql:
WITH overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) as overall_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(eventannotm, 'MISSING') as group_key,
    AVG(instownpct) as group_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY COALESCE(eventannotm, 'MISSING')
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT g.group_key, g.group_avg
  FROM group_stats g
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
  WHERE g.group_avg > om.overall_avg
),
above_avg_records AS (
  SELECT 
    s.instownpct,
    om.overall_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
  WHERE s.instownpct IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE(s.eventannotm, 'MISSING') IN (
      SELECT group_key FROM above_avg
    )
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT AVG(group_avg) FROM above_avg) as mean_of_above_avg_group_means,
  (SELECT AVG(instownpct - overall_avg) FROM above_avg_records) as mean_of_individual_excesses
b.raw: Group records by event announcement timing (with missing timings as their own separate group), calculate each group's mean institutional ownership percentage, identify which groups have a mean strictly exceeding the overall per-snapshot mean institutional ownership, and report a single row containing the mean of those above-average groups' mean ownership values and the mean of those groups' individual excesses above the overall average.

c.request: Looking at announcement timing (`eventannotm`, with a missing timing as its own group), which timings have an average institutional ownership strictly above average? Ignoring missing ownership values, give in one row the mean of those timings' average ownership and how far above average they are on average, without rounding. Compare each timing group's average institutional ownership with the overall per-snapshot average. For the groups above it, report the mean of their averages and their mean excess.
c.sql:
WITH group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(eventannotm, 'Missing') as timing,
    AVG(instownpct) as group_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY eventannotm
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) as overall_average
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  AVG(gs.group_avg) as mean_of_averages,
  AVG(gs.group_avg - oa.overall_average) as mean_excess
FROM group_stats gs, overall_avg oa
WHERE gs.group_avg > oa.overall_average

d.request: Partition records by announcement timing (with NULL/missing as a separate group), calculate each timing group's mean institutional ownership, identify those groups with mean exceeding the overall mean, then report the mean of those above-average group means and the mean of their individual excesses above the overall mean, without rounding.
d.sql: WITH overall_stats AS (SELECT AVG(instownpct) as overall_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals), timing_groups AS (SELECT COALESCE(eventannotm, 'NULL') as timing_group, AVG(instownpct) as group_mean FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm), above_average AS (SELECT tg.group_mean, tg.group_mean - os.overall_avg as excess FROM timing_groups tg CROSS JOIN overall_stats os WHERE tg.group_mean > os.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(group_mean) as mean_of_above_average_group_means, AVG(excess) as mean_of_individual_excesses FROM above_average

a.request: Group the sentiment and fundamentals snapshots by announcement timing (`eventannotm`), treating a missing timing as its own group, and compute each group's average institutional ownership (`instownpct`), ignoring missing values. Take as the baseline the average institutional ownership across all individual snapshots, ignoring missing values, so larger groups weigh more. For the groups whose average is strictly above that baseline, give in one row the mean of their averages and the mean amount by which they exceed the baseline, without rounding.
a.sql:
WITH baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS baseline_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS group_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY COALESCE(eventannotm, 'MISSING')
),
filtered_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    gs.group_avg,
    gs.group_avg - b.baseline_avg AS excess
  FROM group_stats gs
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
  WHERE gs.group_avg > b.baseline_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(group_avg) AS mean_of_group_averages,
  AVG(excess) AS mean_excess
FROM filtered_groups
